Glyoxalate III orthologs are mapping to 
GO:0019243 | methylglyoxal catabolic process to D-lactate via S-lactoyl-glutathione
but as far as I'm aware, glyoxalate III converts methylglyoxal

only Glo1 + Glo2 (glutathione-dependent)
glyoxalase III (Glo3) Is glutathione-independent
Converts methylglyoxal → D-lactate in one step

@edwong57  could you check this before we remove?
S000002941  https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/S000002941
is annotated to glyoxalase III?
I didn't read the paper but the abstract says "glutathione-independent glyoxalases"

author: marcfeuermann
body: Due to the many duplication blocs it is impossible to distinguish what is doing what. I replaced the annotation with a less specific parent term.

author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @marcfeuermann 

I think what you did is correct, but FYI we have obsoleted the children of methylglyoxal catabolic process, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31293
